existing_approved_printer.title: Clear Print Queue - Guide 1
existing_approved_printer.content: Stop the print spooler, clear stuck print jobs, restart the print spooler, and try printing again.

retain_article.title: Printer queue stuck and print jobs will not clear
retain_article.content: Printer queue stuck and print jobs will not clear. Reset printer settings to factory defaults, then clear the pending print jobs and retry printing. Recreate saved printer preferences afterward.
